headline: A 2022 law renames the VA medical center in San Diego after Jennifer Moreno and suggests honoring Kathleen Bruyere with a space inside it.
what_it_does: The law officially renames the Department of Veterans Affairs medical center in San Diego, California, as the Jennifer Moreno Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center. It also states that Congress believes the VA should set aside a prominent physical space in that building to honor Kathleen Mae Bruyere. The second part is a non-binding expression of opinion, not a direct order.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 14, 2022.
